role: academic peer reviewer evaluating a research paper
inline_evidence_example: the phrase "ablations on n_layers are missing" is a complaint that evidences an 'ablation rigor' norm without quoting any norm by name; the phrase "the comparison with DeBERTa-v3 is welcome" is praise that evidences a 'baseline coverage' norm
polarity_hint: Peer reviews on ML conferences (ICLR, NeurIPS) tend to skew negative; reviews on eLife or workshop venues skew positive. Extract both kinds equally.
